judgment_rationale: The claim identifies retail sites, while Section 2(c) limits deployment to designated water-treatment facilities and emergency shelters and expressly excludes other sites under this section.
claim_text: The order authorizes the municipal utility to deploy mobile generators at retail sites throughout the commercial district.
evidence_quote: The municipal utility may deploy mobile generators under this order only at designated water-treatment facilities and emergency shelters. Deployment at other sites is not authorized by this section.
document_excerpt:
Emergency Power Response Order
Section 2(c). The municipal utility may deploy mobile generators under this order only at designated water-treatment facilities and emergency shelters. Deployment at other sites is not authorized by this section.

claim_text: The declaration authorizes participating utilities to suspend competitive procurement requirements for emergency equipment purchases.
evidence_quote: The emergency coordination office shall coordinate the assignment of repair crews and the exchange of outage status reports among participating utilities.
document_excerpt:
Emergency Coordination Declaration
Section 1. A regional power emergency is declared for the affected service area.
Section 2. The emergency coordination office shall coordinate the assignment of repair crews and the exchange of outage status reports among participating utilities.
Section 3. This declaration remains in effect until 6:00 p.m. on September 9, unless renewed by a subsequent written declaration.
judgment_rationale: Section 2 assigns coordination duties concerning repair crews and outage reports but does not address procurement requirements or authorize their suspension. The excerpt therefore does not determine the claim.

claim_text: The order remains effective through 11:59 p.m. on May 18 unless earlier rescinded.
evidence_quote: This order takes effect at 6:00 p.m. on May 14 and remains in force through 11:59 p.m. on May 18, unless earlier rescinded by the issuing authority.
document_excerpt:
Emergency Power Response Order
Section 4(a). This order takes effect at 6:00 p.m. on May 14 and remains in force through 11:59 p.m. on May 18, unless earlier rescinded by the issuing authority.
judgment_rationale: Section 4(a) expressly sets the end of the order's effective period at 11:59 p.m. on May 18, subject to earlier rescission.
